issues.message: 初稿全部引用未成功获取正文的 Cambridge 页面，不能据此声称该页支持具体义项、搭配或构词。改用实际取得的英语词条，并仅为其明确支持的内容保留引用；其余专业语言补充不挂靠该来源。
论证说服力与信号强度被合为一义，各只有一个例句，近反义说明也只适用于论证。须拆开，并分别补足两个例句及对应表达。
遗漏“某科目或技能较差”和“饮品味淡、浓度低”两个常用义；学习计划已提及 weak in，却没有对应教学内容。
意志软弱及缺乏实力、影响力或执行能力均属常用延伸义，不宜只放在次要义项中各举一例。政府 weak 也不必然表示法定权力少，应区分权力、实力与执行能力。
原例句只使用 week，却绑定身体虚弱义。改为同时出现 weak 和 week 的自然例句，使 senseId 确实对应句中用法。
weak evidence for something 是名词搭配，应标为 common-collocation。

review.coverageAssessment: 已核对所给中文释义、实际取得的英语词条及常用英语用法。修订后覆盖身体虚弱、结构不牢、论证不充分、强度微弱、能力欠佳、味淡、意志软弱及实力或影响力不足，每个主要义均有两个具体原创例句。原有读音、规则比较形式及词族拼写可保留。实际来源只给出概括义和少量词汇关系，不能充当全部细分用法的逐项出处；其词源段仅有待补标记，没有可用的历史词源信息，因此保留非历史助记，不新增历史阶段或历史词源引用。本次为独立模型审校。

senseInventory.sense: 形容词：身体虚弱、肌肉或身体部位力量不足
senseInventory.assessment: 原稿两例覆盖充分；修正来源引用即可。

senseInventory.sense: 形容词：结构或材料不牢固、强度不足
senseInventory.assessment: 原稿两例自然，近反义语境基本准确；撤去无正文支持的来源引用。

senseInventory.sense: 形容词：论据、理由、证据等说服力不足
senseInventory.assessment: 移出信号义，补足第二个论证例句，并调整标题、释义及搭配。

senseInventory.sense: 形容词：信号、声音等强度低、微弱
senseInventory.assessment: 从论证义中独立，分别用手机信号和声音举例。

senseInventory.sense: 形容词：某科目、技能或能力较差
senseInventory.assessment: 补入常用义，区分 weak in 与 weak at 的常见搭配。

senseInventory.sense: 形容词：饮品味淡、浓度低
senseInventory.assessment: 补入 weak tea、weak coffee，说明此处 strong 表示味浓。

senseInventory.sense: 形容词：意志薄弱、容易屈服
senseInventory.assessment: 提升为主要义，补足两例及 weak-willed、strong-willed 等对应表达。

senseInventory.sense: 形容词：缺乏实力、影响力或执行能力
senseInventory.assessment: 提升为主要义，以政府执行能力和谈判地位举例，避免等同于完全没有权力。

{"id":"weak-intensity","title":"微弱；强度低","meaning":"形容信号、声音等强度不足。","usageNote":"常见于手机信号不佳、声音轻弱等情境；具体强度要看所修饰的名词。","examples":[{"id":"weak-intensity-ex1","senseId":"weak-intensity","en":"We received a weak phone signal in the basement.","zh":"我们在地下室收到的手机信号很弱。","note":"weak signal 表示信号强度低。"},{"id":"weak-intensity-ex2","senseId":"weak-intensity","en":"Her voice was so weak that I had to move closer to hear her.","zh":"她的声音很微弱，我得靠近些才能听清。","note":"weak voice 描写声音轻弱、缺乏力量。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"The signal is weak.","zh":"信号很弱。","note":"weak 作表语说明信号强度。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"a weak signal","zh":"微弱的信号","note":"常用于手机、无线电等信号。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"a weak voice","zh":"微弱的声音","note":"常形容说话声轻弱无力。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"faint","zh":"微弱的；不易察觉的","note":"用于声音或信号时，强调难以听见或察觉。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"strong","zh":"强的；有力的","note":"strong signal 指强信号；strong voice 指有力的声音。"}],"similarNote":"faint 侧重不易察觉，weak 侧重强度或力量不足。","contrastingNote":"此义中常用 strong 对照；形容声音时，loud 则专门强调音量大。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"weak-ability","title":"某科目或技能较差","meaning":"形容人在某一方面能力不足、不擅长，或某项技能比较薄弱。","usageNote":"科目或领域常接 weak in；具体活动常接 weak at，后面可用名词或动名词。两种介词的用法存在重叠。","examples":[{"id":"weak-ability-ex1","senseId":"weak-ability","en":"I'm weak in maths, so I practise a little every day.","zh":"我的数学比较差，所以我每天都练习一点。","note":"weak in maths 表示数学是薄弱科目。"},{"id":"weak-ability-ex2","senseId":"weak-ability","en":"Ben is weak at spelling, so he checks difficult words in a dictionary.","zh":"本不擅长拼写，所以他会用词典核对难词。","note":"weak at spelling 表示拼写能力较差。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"be weak in a subject","zh":"某门功课较差","note":"如 weak in maths；in 常引出科目或领域。","kind":"sentence-pattern"},{"en":"be weak at doing something","zh":"不擅长做某事","note":"at 后可接动名词，如 spelling。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"weak reading skills","zh":"薄弱的阅读能力","note":"weak 可直接修饰某项技能。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"poor at","zh":"不擅长","note":"常接活动名称或动名词，如 poor at spelling。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"good at","zh":"擅长","note":"用于具体活动或技能，与 weak at 对照。"},{"en":"strong in","zh":"在某方面能力强","note":"常用于科目或领域，如 strong in maths。"}],"similarNote":"此处 weak 表示能力较差；poor at 也用于说明某人不擅长某事。","contrastingNote":"根据原搭配选择 good at 或 strong in，不要把介词组合机械互换。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"weak-concentration","title":"味淡；浓度低","meaning":"形容茶、咖啡等饮品味道不浓，或溶液浓度低。","usageNote":"日常尤其常见于 weak tea、weak coffee；描述的是浓淡，不是在说饮品让人虚弱。","examples":[{"id":"weak-concentration-ex1","senseId":"weak-concentration","en":"The tea was too weak, so I left the tea bag in for another minute.","zh":"茶太淡了，所以我让茶包又泡了一分钟。","note":"weak tea 指茶味淡。"},{"id":"weak-concentration-ex2","senseId":"weak-concentration","en":"This coffee is too weak for me; I'll use more coffee next time.","zh":"这杯咖啡对我来说太淡了；下次我会多放些咖啡。","note":"weak coffee 指咖啡不够浓。"}],"patterns":[],"collocations":[{"en":"weak tea","zh":"淡茶","note":"与 strong tea（浓茶）相对。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"weak coffee","zh":"淡咖啡","note":"表示咖啡味不浓。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"watery","zh":"水分过多、寡淡的","note":"形容饮品时常带不满，强调喝起来像水、缺少味道。"},{"en":"diluted","zh":"被稀释的","note":"说明经过加水等稀释过程；weak 本身只说明浓度或味道较淡。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"strong","zh":"浓的","note":"strong tea、strong coffee 分别表示浓茶、浓咖啡。"}],"similarNote":"weak 不一定表示后来加了水，也可能是泡茶时间短或咖啡用量少。","contrastingNote":"此处 strong 表示味浓，不表示饮用者身体强壮。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"weak-character","title":"意志薄弱；软弱","meaning":"形容人缺乏坚定的意志，容易向压力或诱惑屈服。","usageNote":"用于评价人的性格或某次表现，常带批评意味；不单凭身体虚弱就作这种判断。","examples":[{"id":"weak-character-ex1","senseId":"weak-character","en":"He was too weak to say no to his friends.","zh":"他意志太薄弱，没法拒绝朋友。","note":"too weak to 在这里指缺乏坚持拒绝的意志。"},{"id":"weak-character-ex2","senseId":"weak-character","en":"I was weak and let the children stay up after they begged me.","zh":"孩子们一央求，我就心软了，让他们晚睡。","note":"weak 在这里说明没有坚持原先的要求。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"too weak to say no","zh":"软弱得无法拒绝","note":"说明在他人压力下难以坚持立场。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"a weak character","zh":"软弱的性格","note":"这里的 character 指性格。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"weak-willed","zh":"意志薄弱的","note":"专门描述意志不坚定；weak 的使用范围更广。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"strong-willed","zh":"意志坚定的","note":"强调有坚定意志、不容易被左右。"},{"en":"firm","zh":"坚定的","note":"用于立场或对待他人的态度，强调坚持决定。"}],"similarNote":"需要明确说意志薄弱时可用 weak-willed；weak 要结合上下文理解。","contrastingNote":"strong-willed 强调意志，firm 强调态度或立场坚定。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"weak-power","title":"实力、影响力或执行能力不足","meaning":"形容政府、组织或人在某种关系中实力不足、影响有限，或难以有效行使权力。","usageNote":"常见于组织、政治或谈判语境；weak government 可能强调执行不力，并不必然表示法定权力少。","examples":[{"id":"weak-power-ex1","senseId":"weak-power","en":"The weak local government struggled to enforce the rules.","zh":"这个执行能力薄弱的地方政府很难落实这些规定。","note":"此处根据 enforce the rules 理解为执行能力不足。"},{"id":"weak-power-ex2","senseId":"weak-power","en":"With no other job offers, she was in a weak position when discussing her salary.","zh":"由于没有其他工作邀约，她在商谈薪水时处于弱势。","note":"a weak position 表示缺少谈判优势。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"be in a weak position","zh":"处于弱势","note":"可指谈判或竞争中的地位不利。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"a weak government","zh":"软弱无力的政府","note":"可强调实力、影响力或执行能力不足，具体看上下文。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"powerless","zh":"无能为力的；没有权力的","note":"比 weak 更接近没有有效行动能力或权力；weak 通常只表示相对不足。"},{"en":"ineffective","zh":"不起作用的；效率低的","note":"着重行动未产生预期效果，不直接说明掌握多少权力。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"powerful","zh":"有权势的；有影响力的","note":"用于权势或影响力的对照。"},{"en":"strong","zh":"强有力的；占优势的","note":"如 a strong government 或 a strong negotiating position。"}],"similarNote":"根据语境判断 weak 指实力不足还是执行不力，不要一律译成完全没有权力。","contrastingNote":"权势可用 powerful 对照；政府能力或谈判地位常用 strong 对照。"},"sourceIds":[]}

patches.expectedValueJson: [{"id":"weak-power","title":"权力或影响力较弱","meaning":"形容政府、组织或人在某种关系中缺少权力或影响力。","note":"常见于政治、社会或组织语境。","example":{"id":"weak-power-ex1","senseId":"weak-power","en":"The weak local government struggled to enforce the rules.","zh":"这个权力薄弱的地方政府很难执行这些规定。","note":"weak 描写政府执行权力的能力有限。"},"sourceIds":["cambridge-weak"]},{"id":"weak-character","title":"意志薄弱；软弱","meaning":"形容人缺乏坚定的意志，容易屈服或改变主意。","note":"此义评价人的性格或表现，语气可能带批评。","example":{"id":"weak-character-ex1","senseId":"weak-character","en":"He was too weak to say no to his friends.","zh":"他意志太薄弱，没法拒绝朋友。","note":"too weak to 在这里指缺乏坚持拒绝的意志。"},"sourceIds":["cambridge-weak"]}]
